title: feat(grid): a list cell's right-click menu copies, pastes and clears that cell
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8TkiiiqHvFYXaB2vYtLWWEC)_

Fixes #36289

Clause-②: yes (widening) — an optional `cell` member on the context `data-table` hands a host's `renderRowContextMenu`, and five new `table.*` language-pack keys in every locale
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表里在格子上点右键，菜单上半段多了这个格子的「复制、粘贴、清空」，后面接着已有的「修改历史」；一条分隔线下面还是原来整行的「打开、在新标签页打开、编辑、删除」，内容和顺序都没动。
- 属于「列表专题」里对照 Attio 定的第 2 条：右键菜单放格子自己的动作，同时保留整行的动作。
- 出错时最多是菜单项该灰没灰、或格子上的提示不对；粘贴和在格子里直接输入走同一套检查和保存（邮箱格粘贴非邮箱文字、清空必填格都会被拒并说明原因），不会存进不合规的值，可以整体撤回。
- 无

## What changes

**The table** (`@object-ui/components`, `data-table`)
- `renderRowContextMenu` now also receives `context.cell` whenever it receives `context.column`: `copy`, `paste`, `clear` for that data cell, each absent where the table would refuse it. `copy` is the Ctrl/Cmd+C path (one function now, `copyCellValue`; a masked cell copies nothing, so `copy` is absent there). `paste` reads `navigator.clipboard.readText()` inside the click that chose it and writes the text through `pasteIntoCell`, the selected-cell paste path. `clear` is `clearCell`, the Backspace path. `paste` and `clear` are absent on a cell `readOnlyReasonOf` refuses; `clear` also on a two-state cell and on a cell whose facts carry a `clearRefusal` (required).
- `pasteIntoCell` now holds the converted value to the cell editor's own check (`GridCellFacts.validate`: required, length, range, email / URL shape) before it writes, and says on the cell why when the check refuses or the text stands for no value of the column (`table.pasteNotValue`). Before, a paste into an email cell sent any text to be saved, and text a number or lookup cell cannot read was dropped without a word.
- A clipboard the browser will not hand over (no API, permission declined) puts `table.pasteUnavailable` on the cell, which names Ctrl/Cmd+V.
- A cell item's write waits until the menu has closed and focus is back on the cell (`whenRowContextMenuClosed`); otherwise that focus move dismisses the note the write puts on the cell.

**The list** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`)
- `RowContextMenuItems` draws two sections: the cell's **Copy**, **Paste**, **Clear**, then **Change history** (moved up from the row's items), a separator, then the row's items in their existing order (Open, Open in new tab, the row's actions). Unavailable items are drawn disabled.
- `ObjectGrid` passes the table's `cell` through, and draws Paste unavailable on a field type pasted text cannot stand for (`pastesFromText` in `objectGridCellFacts.ts`: text, textarea, email, url, phone, number, currency, percent, date, datetime, select, radio). A lookup, a person, a multi-choice and other types: Paste unavailable.
- A grid with no row action and no selection still keeps the browser's menu unless the cell can be changed (Paste or Clear available) or has a change history; Copy alone does not take the browser's menu away.

**Language packs** — `table.copyCell`, `table.pasteCell`, `table.clearCell`, `table.pasteNotValue`, `table.pasteUnavailable` in all 11 locales (`zh-Hant` regenerated from `zh-Hans` by `gen:zh-hant`); the two notes are mirrored in the table's English defaults.

**Docs** — "A cell's own menu items" in `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` and the plugin-grid README.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/cellContextMenu-36289.test.tsx` (12), through the real `ObjectGrid` → `data-table` chain with a data source recording each `update`: the section order (cell items, separator, `row-context-open` below it); a right-click on the selection cell opens the row's section only; Copy writes the cell's text; Paste writes and saves (`update('account', 'r2', { notes })`); Paste of `not an address` into an email cell saves nothing and shows `Please enter a valid email address`; Ctrl+V on the selected cell refuses the same text the same way (CONTROL: a real address saves); a refused clipboard read says so on the cell; Clear saves `null`; Clear disabled on a required field (CONTROL: enabled on an optional one); a read-only field has Copy only; a lookup and a multi-select have Paste disabled and Clear enabled; a grid that is not editable has Copy only.
- `data-table-row-context-menu-28434.test.tsx`: the host context now carries `cell` (`{ copy }` on a table the reader cannot edit), plus two cases: an editable cell hands `copy`, `paste`, `clear` and `copy` writes the value; a masked, non-editable cell hands none.
- `rowContextMenu-28434.test.tsx` and `phoneCardRowActions-29150.test.tsx` compare the row's section only: a menu opened on a data cell now lists the cell's items first.

## Acceptance notes

- Agreed with the seat before code: Ctrl/Cmd+V on the selected cell reads the same `pasteIntoCell`, so it now refuses what the editor refuses and says why when the text stands for no value, where it used to save or drop silently. Keyboard bindings are unchanged.
- Change history moved from the row's items to the cell's section, as the card's layout asks; the row's own items keep their content and order (the queued row-order card is not touched).
- The card's unverified point on pasting into a reference, person or multi-choice field: Paste is drawn unavailable there, as the card proposed. Ctrl+V on a multi-choice cell still matches options by name as before.
- An unsaved view draft is unaffected by a paste: a paste writes the record through the same per-cell save as typing, which never reads or writes the view draft. Checked in the browser (frames 8a/8b): with an unsaved draft sort by Company showing its Discard / Save bar, a paste into a contact's Company cell sent only `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_contact/RECORD_ID {"company":…}`; the draft bar, the draft sort and the row order were unchanged after it.

## Verification

Checked in a browser on the showcase app (`examples/app-showcase`, local dev stack, this branch's head). GitHub takes image uploads from a browser only, so the twelve frames are attached in the project's card thread; what each one shows:

| Frame | What it shows |
|---|---|
| `1-cell-menu` | Right-click on a contact's Company cell (en): Copy, Paste, Clear, Change history, a separator, then Open, Open in new tab, Edit, Delete |
| `zh-1-cell-menu`, `zh-2-contact-cell-menu` | The same menu in zh-CN on a project's Name cell and a contact's Company cell: 复制 / 粘贴 / 清空 / 修改历史, separator, 打开 / 在新标签页打开 / 编辑 / 删除 |
| `2-required-clear-grey` | Full name (required): Clear disabled, Copy and Paste enabled |
| `3a-before-paste`, `3b-pasted-saved` | Company copied from one contact and pasted into another's: the cell shows the new value and the request is `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_contact/RECORD_ID {"company":"华宁科技"}` |
| `4-email-refused` | Pasting `not an address` into an Email cell: the cell's note says "Please enter a valid email address" and no request is sent |
| `5-checkbox-row-only` | Right-click on the selection checkbox: the row's section only (Open, Open in new tab, Edit, Delete) |
| `6-lookup-paste-grey` | A project's Account (a required lookup): Paste and Clear disabled, Copy enabled |
| `7-formula-readonly` | A project's Remaining budget (a formula): Paste and Clear disabled, Copy enabled |
| `8a-draft-sort-before-paste`, `8b-draft-sort-after-paste` | An unsaved draft sort with its Discard / Save bar, before and after a paste: draft and row order unchanged, only the record PATCH sent |

Two-minute check: on any list, right-click a text cell. Expect Copy, Paste, Clear (and Change history) above a line and Open, Open in new tab, Edit, Delete below it; on a required field Clear is grey.
